paragraphs.text: Aladdin was a rogue from Rabiah , famous for his lamp and his ring, and his artifact -thieving skills. Aladdin's destructive ring was gifted by a magician, who told him it was a formidable talisman against evil, as long as Aladdin kept obeying the magician. Aladdin's lamp, a relic of legend, allowed its bearer to shape destiny, turning uncertainty into opportunity, much like the fabled wishes of old.

In One Thousand and One Nights , the inspiration for the set Arabian Nights , Aladdin was a young man tricked by an evil magician to recover a lamp with a djinn inside. He defeated the wizard and married a princess. In the original story, he is Chinese, and is depicted as such on his card. When first printed in Arabian Nights , Aladdin had the unique Creature type of Aladdin . This was given errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to be Human Rogue .
